stories.title: US military base vital to home security, says MP

stories.title: Cuts to child health services after council vote
stories.summary: The Labour MP for Ipswich says the decision brings "another dark day for children and families".

stories.title: Man dies in four-vehicle crash in suburban street
stories.summary: Police are trying to find out if the driver who died had a medical incident before the crash.

stories.title: Women Rise Together's business awards triumph

stories.title: Watch: Erosion threatens home of Darkness singer's parents
stories.summary: Justin Hawkins says his parents have lived in the property on the Suffolk coast for about 20 years.

stories.title: Sixth form to remain open while options explored
stories.summary: The sixth form paused Year 12 admissions in September.

stories.title: 'We don't want to be the next village lost to erosion'

stories.title: Mayor will be elected to help run Norfolk and Suffolk
